source_scope: All50 formal original expert HDF numeric arrays, verified against original source manifest SHA

metric_contract.joint_angle_unit: rad; reported derived angles in degrees
metric_contract.dense_state_path: initial measured_before[0] concatenated with every measured_after
metric_contract.preclose_definition: Before/on first applied SDK command <950 in any first-five flexion channels; excludes thumb rotation; not first physical contact
metric_contract.so3_path: Sum of unsigned nearest SO(3) increments at actual60ms camera observations; distinct from same-axis winding
metric_contract.so3_end_angle: First-last shortest SO(3) distance is bounded0..180deg; does not count whole turns
metric_contract.ee_and_camera_position_paths: Actual saved60ms pose/matrix translation samples, no interpolation/FK or image-generated estimates
metric_contract.ee_pose_semantics: RoboTwin corrected legacy world EE frame from collection adapter, including its fixed local+0.06m convention; not calibrated real-robot TCP
metric_contract.matrix_translation_semantics: Camera-to-world model matrix as specified by collection provenance; matrix header extrinsics alone does not prove this convention
